name: @francisdesjardins/beadc
description: beadc, Bead's builder: compiles a .proto with buf into a blueprint, bead-blueprint/1, and checks a .proto or a blueprint by rule name.
author: Francis Desjardins <francis.desjardins@gmail.com>

scripts.check: yarn type-check && yarn lint --deny-warnings && yarn format:check && yarn buf:lint && yarn buf:format && yarn options:check
scripts.type-check: node node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc -p test/golden/typescript/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc -p test/golden/typescript/tsconfig.floor.json && node node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc -p test/consumer/tsconfig.json
